test_title: PYST 06: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1
solution:
The correct answer is '**use of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses traditional medicines and their natural products.
 
• The appropriate phrase should indicate how these medicines are made from natural products.
 
• "**Use of**" fits well as it accurately describes the utilization of natural products in traditional medicines.
 
• Other options ("**used off**", "**uses of**", "**used of**") do not fit correctly in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Traditional medicines (TMs) make (1) _______ natural products and are of great importance. Such forms of medicine as traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), Ayurveda, Kampo, traditional Korean medicine (TKM), and Unani (2) _______ natural products and have been (3) _______ all over the world for hundreds or even thousands of years, and they (4) _______ blossomed into orderly-regulated systems of medicine. In their various forms, they may have certain defects, but they (5) _______ still a valuable repository of human knowledge.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Used off: "Used off" is not a grammatically correct phrase in this context.
 
• Uses of: "Uses of" does not fit properly into the structure of the sentence.
 
• Used of: "Used of" is not a grammatically correct phrase.
